name: Keilah
overview: Keilah is identified as one of nine cities in the southern region of Palestine allotted to the tribe of Judah, emphasizing its geographical and tribal significance. The sample verses from Nehemiah highlight the city's leadership role during the post-exilic period, where rulers of Keilah actively participated in the restoration of Jerusalem's walls, demonstrating their commitment to the community's spiritual and physical rebuilding. This underscores Keilah's enduring importance from its initial allocation to Judah through the time of Israel's restoration.
